subject: general
question: Chlorophyll pigment is present in which of the following components of a cell?
solution:
The correct answer is Chloroplasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Chlorophyll is a green pigment that is responsible for photosynthesis in plants.
 
• Chloroplasts are organelles found in plant cells that contain chlorophyll and are responsible for photosynthesis.
 
• The manufacture of active substances such vitamins, lipids, amino acids, phytohormones, nucleotides, and secondary metabolites is carried out by chloroplasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ribosomes are involved in protein synthesis.
 
 
• The messenger RNA (mRNA) sequence is read by the ribosome, which then converts the genetic code into a specific string of amino acids. These amino acids develop into long chains and fold to form proteins.
 
 
 
• Mitochondria are responsible for cellular respiration.
 
 
• Adenosine triphosphate, a little molecule, stores the chemical energy generated by the mitochondria. 
 
 
 
• Lysosomes are responsible for breaking down waste material.
 
 
• They disintegrate extraneous or worn-out cell components.
 
• They could be applied to eliminate bacterial and viral invaders.
